sentences.en: The house is opposite the church. You can't miss it.
sentences.zh: 这栋房子就在教堂对面。你不会错过的。

sentences.en: This church is not a big one, as churches go.
sentences.zh: 这所教堂不算大，按教堂的标准来说。

sentences.en: We could hear the donnnng ... donnnng of the church bells nearby.
sentences.zh: 附近教堂的钟声叮当……叮当响个不停。

senses.zh: 领…到教堂接受宗教仪式 Church丘奇(姓氏)
